next.reason: 1985 allows several SAME clauses (§2023:12.4.6.2 '{ same-clause }...') with (a) a file in at most one SAME RECORD AREA, (b) a sort/merge file in at most one SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA, (c) a non-sort file named in a SAME (AREA) clause and in sort-area clauses requires all that clause's files in those sort-area clauses. §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR6 and SR7 limit a sort file and an ordinary file to one record-area clause and a sort file to one sort-merge-area clause; SR10 restates (c) for the file-area format. Report files were already barred from SAME RECORD (1985 XIII.2.4.3 SR2), matching SR5. Same refusals.
